sources.title: Assemblée nationale QE 29143 — répartition allocations familiales / nationalité
sources.claim: AF beneficiaries ~5M for 12.4 Md€; ~2% EEE+Suisse, ~6% étrangers hors EEE; CNAF no finer nationality amounts
sources.champ: CNAF allocations familiales, situation au 31/12/2013; % = share of beneficiaries not of spend
sources.note: Réponse JO 30/12/2014. Maghreb/Muslim NOT in source. Soft-hold inventing Maghreb from hors EEE. PDF: https://www.assemblee-nationale.fr/dyn/14/questions/QANR5L14QE29143.pdf Local: downloads/AN-Q29143-AF-nationalite.pdf

sources.title: Sénat QE qSEQ140210272 — CNAF AF EEE vs hors EEE
sources.claim: Near 5M AF beneficiaries, 12.7 Md€; ~2% EEE+Suisse, ~6% hors EEE; CNAF has no nationality amounts beyond those two buckets
sources.note: Réponse ministère 12/05/2016. Explicit 'ne dispose pas de données par nationalité'. Maghreb NOT in source.

sources.title: Assemblée nationale QE 5157 — bénéficiaires étrangers du RSA
sources.claim: Less than 300000 RSA foyers with dossier head from hors UE/EEE = 15.6% of RSA foyers; 88.4% of non-French-nationality RSA foyers
sources.champ: CNAF+CCMSA, 30/06/2022; nationality of responsable de dossier
sources.note: Réponse JO 20/06/2023. Not Maghreb; not immigrés (naturalised = French). No EUR for subset.

sources.title: Assemblée nationale QE 5530 — bénéficiaires étrangers des aides au logement (APL)
sources.claim: Extra-community households = 14.8% of APL beneficiaries (859554 households) and 16.4% of APL spend (2.4 Md€)
sources.champ: APL ménages extra-communautaires; year of figures NOT stated in JO answer published 11/04/2023
sources.note: PASS-LOW because reference year missing. Maghreb NOT in source. PDF: .../QANR5L16QE5530.pdf

sources.title: INSEE RPM 2024 F18 — Niveau de vie et pauvreté des immigrés (ERFS 2021)
sources.claim: Non-contributory social benefits = 11.1% of immigrés living standard (2410€) vs 5.6% non-immigrés (1530€); Africa-born immigrés 16.4% (3110€)
sources.champ: France métropolitaine, logement ordinaire, ERFS 2021; prestations = PF+logement+minima+PPA (excl. pensions, chômage)
sources.note: PDF https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/fichier/7941405/RPM2024-F18.pdf Local downloads/INSEE-RPM2024-F18-immigres.pdf. 'Nés en Afrique' = continent NOT Maghreb-only; religion absent. Share of living standard ≠ share of CAF budget.

sources.title: INSEE RPM 2024 — Prestations sociales (aggregate, no nationality)
sources.claim: 63.3 Md€ non-contributory benefits to ordinary households; 12.9M households (44%) receive at least one
sources.champ: FR métro ERFS 2021; no immigrant split on this page
sources.note: Context denominator only. Do not invent nationality split.

sources.title: Assemblée nationale QE 4877 — ASPA / nationalité
sources.claim: CNAV does not record nationality of ASPA beneficiaries — no nationality data available
sources.champ: ASPA / minimum vieillesse; caisses de retraite + SASPA
sources.note: Réponse JO 27/06/2023. Primary gap cite. Maghreb/Muslim N/A.

sources.title: Assemblée nationale QE 6272 — transparence nationalité RSA et ASPA (unanswered)
sources.claim: Parliamentary demand for RSA/ASPA beneficiaries by nationality since 2017; no government answer at dig time
sources.note: Published 29/04/2025; renewed 03/03/2026. Evidence that fine nationality series remain unavailable publicly.

sources.title: Cour des comptes — La lutte contre les fraudes aux prestations sociales
sources.claim: Branche famille estimated fraud 2.3 Md€ in 2018; CAF detected ~13%; CAF residual wrong payments ~3 Md€ (4.5%); multi-organism detected ~1 Md€ in 2019
sources.champ: Fraude/erreurs — NO nationality or immigrant split
sources.note: FRAUDE section only. Do not mix with legal immigrant spend. Report date 08/09/2020.

sources.title: Assemblée nationale QE 4323 — fraude sociale / résultats CAF 2024
sources.claim: CAF characterized frauds 49030 (+5%); prejudice 449.2 M€ (+20% vs 2023) including 28 M€ from 10% surcharge
sources.champ: Branche famille detected fraud 2024; no nationality split
sources.note: FRAUDE detected ≠ legal spend. Separated from section A.

sources.title: Cour des comptes — Certification comptes régime général / CNAF exercice 2024
sources.claim: Inability to certify CNAF/family branch accounts; 6.3 Md€ uncorrected errors after 24 months = 8% of benefits (RSA, PPA, housing aids)
sources.champ: Erreurs de liquidations — NOT fraude; no nationality
sources.note: Label as ERRORS not fraud. Do not attribute to immigrants.

sources.title: AFP Factuel quoting CNAF — part étrangers parmi foyers allocataires
sources.claim: CNAF told AFP (28 Oct 2025): end-2022, all benefits, 11% of 13.5M allocataire households are foreign nationality; viral 42% is false
sources.champ: CNAF all prestations fin 2022 — via AFP paraphrase not CNAF URL
sources.note: PASS-LOW: secondary quoting CNAF; caf.fr maintenance blocked direct fetch. Debunks 42%. Maghreb NOT stated.

sources.title: CNAF MREIC 2024 — droits des migrants aux prestations familiales (eligibility law, not spend)
sources.claim: Comparative eligibility conditions for foreigners (residence/stay); no French spend-by-nationality table
sources.note: Useful for eligibility context; NOT a Maghreb spend figure. caf.fr may be intermittent.

sources.title: INSEE Immigrés et descendants 2023 — Niveau de vie et pauvreté monétaire (ERFS 2019)
sources.claim: Prestations sociales share of living standard: immigrés 12%, descendants 10%, sans ascendance 5%; Africa-born immigrés 18%, Europe-born 6%
sources.champ: FR métro ERFS 2019; prestations = famille/logement/minima/PPA; excl. pensions/chômage; ascendance migratoire (not religion)
sources.note: Adds DESENDANTS series absent from RPM2024-F18. Soft-hold: Afrique ≠ Maghreb ≠ Muslim. Aligns directionally with 2021 F18 (11.1/5.6/16.4). Related metrics.json in pack is from aides-ascendance gate.
